title: Nintendo confident in memory supply in new financial report
description: As part of the company's quarterly financial report, company president Shuntaro Furukawa affirmed that Nintendo is not suffering due to the ongoing memory crisis, and is confident it has enough supply.

title: My game was cloned with AI... what do I do?
description: Turns out: no one is immune to AI-generated clone games.

title: Tripwire Interactive expands publishing business to focus on smaller developers and games
description: The publishing division of Tripwire Interactive seeks to broaden its initiative with a focus on smaller games with scaled support.

title: Ubisoft among the bidders for Arkane as Xbox looks to sell the studio
description: The Lyon-based studio has a few options on the table to avoid studio closure, including an acquisition from fellow-French video game industry contemporary Ubisoft.

title: Valve warns of slower Steam approvals, possibly due to AI game surge
description: New games on Valve's Steam platform are getting delayed due to an extended approval process, which Valve does not directly attribute to any kind of development trend.

title: Half of Control Resonant's players were 'new' to the franchise
description: Players unfamiliar with Remedy's 'new weird' action series helped drive Control Resonant to over one million units sold in just three weeks.

title: Former Xbox COO Helen Chiang pushes back on characterizations of her departure
description: As rumors spread about her abrupt departure, Xbox's former COO Helen Chiang fires back, denying much of what has said about why the Microsoft veteran left the company.

title: What Rami Ismail learned with his return to game development
description: Indie dev advocate Rami Ismail has returned to making games after six years away from active development.

title: South of Midnight director was 'always worried' about 'Rome burning' at Xbox
description: South of Midnight's former director says, were he making the call, he would not have funded the game he directed—believing that it was only a matter of time until "Rome burns."

title: Toshihiro Nagoshi's post-Sega game studio, Nagoshi Studio, shuts down after NetEase funding cuts
description: Founded in 2021, the studio was working on a game funded by NetEase announced just under a year ago, but the studio has reportedly collapsed.

title: The number of game pages doubles on Itch.io as AI games flood the store
description: The indie video game store that prides itself as an open marketplace is being deluged by game pages, doubling the usual number without a proportional increase in sales.

title: Zelda producer: Ocarina of Time remake helps junior staff learn classic insights
description: The latest The Legend of Zelda title remakes one of the series' most beloved games, which Eiji Aonuma chose to pursue to help junior staff think about the modern games differently.

title: Anthropic orders AI tool Claude to stop remaking video games
description: Update: Anthropic has confirmed it's released an update to Opus 5.5 to "steer" Claude Code away from "recreating someone else's specific game."

title: Roblox growth slumps, but the company is betting big on AI to compensate
description: Roblox's quarterly financial results missed their daily active user goals, but the company plans to make up for it somehow with AI.

title: John Romero's canceled game finds a new publisher amidst an overall scope change
description: John Romero's game was canceled by Xbox and his studio was on the verge of total collapse, but a new publisher has picked it up and Romero has managed to retain some of his team.

title: Report: EA shut down BioWare in favor of Star Wars: Battlefront sequel after previously decrying licensed games
description: According to a new report, Electronic Arts closed down the venerated RPG studio BioWare to shift resources away from Mass Effect and toward a new Star Wars: Battlefront title.

title: The History of Every Video Game Genre
description: From racing and sports, to shoot 'em ups and platformers, to fighting games and first-person shooters, to cozy games and friendslop, this is the history of every video game genre. Ever.

title: Word Play is now available on iOS!
description: Word Play is now available on iPhone and iPad. Get the free trial here

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
